description: Run the same Jira / Azure DevOps → SimplifyQA sync as the integration screen's Sync button, for one mapped issue / work item type of the active project. With test: true it instead runs a TWO-WAY TEST: it creates a marked test issue / work item in Jira or Azure DevOps and checks it arrives in SimplifyQA, creates a test Defect in SimplifyQA and checks it arrives on the other side, then deletes all of them; use it after saving, fix what fails and test again. TWO STEPS: call WITHOUT confirmToken to check the SAVED configuration (every mandatory SimplifyQA field of that module must be mapped or have a default, or record creation fails) and get a confirm token; only after the user explicitly says to run it, call again with the token. The sync runs in the background and writes records into SimplifyQA; read the outcome with integration_logs.

test.description: Run the two-way test instead of a full sync

type.description: The mapped Jira issue type / Azure DevOps work item type, e.g. "Bug1"

name: integration_sync
title: Run integration sync
